summary: Writes transform data to a named shared memory block that another TouchDesigner process can read with Shared Mem In COMP, allowing object transforms to be exchanged between processes.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Controls whether the node cooks every frame and writes data

key_params.name: name
key_params.note: Shared memory block name to write

key_params.name: opviewer
key_params.note: Operator viewer used for node viewer when configured

key_params.name: enablecloning
key_params.note: Enable active cloning from a clone master

key_params.name: externaltox
key_params.note: External .tox source path for the component

key_params.name: relpath
key_params.note: Relative file path behavior for child file paths

key_concepts: Shared Mem Out COMP writes transform data to a named shared memory block for another TouchDesigner process to read.
Active controls whether the node cooks every frame and keeps publishing transform data.
The Shared Mem Name parameter defines the writer block name that Shared Mem In COMP readers must match.
The operator exchanges transform data only; other shared-memory data types use the corresponding TOP or CHOP operators.
Current docs note license availability for Educational, Commercial, and Pro, while the page text also states Commercial/Pro availability.
common_gotchas: Shared Mem Out COMP requires TouchDesigner Educational, Commercial, or Pro according to current docs, and the page text also notes Commercial/Pro availability.
It writes transform data only; use the Shared Mem TOP/CHOP family for other data types.
Active must be on for frame-by-frame writing.
Readers must use the exact same Shared Mem Name.
Multiple writers with the same name can create ambiguous or overwritten transform data.
Because this is cross-process state, validate lifecycle order so the reader is not waiting on a block that has not been created yet.
